module: Canonical formatting table for header names (MIME/HTTP) of LuaSocket: maps a lowercase name to its usual form (e.g. 'content-type' -> 'Content-Type'). The module also registers itself in socket.headers. Used by socket.http when sending request headers.
notes: The module does require('socket.socket') (and not libs/luasocket/socket/socket), which assumes that this module name is resolvable by the game's search path.

canonic.desc: Lowercase header names to their canonical capitalization; a name absent from the table is sent as is.
